_meta.description: Map generation rules per trail difficulty. Single starting point, branches and reconnections, single destination. All paths lead to the final node. Harder branches offer better rewards but more risk. FTL/StS-style galactic map — visually distinct per trail.
_meta.visual_note: Lunar maps are blue-gray and close, rocky. Mars maps are warm amber, dusty. Interstellar maps are deep indigo to black with distant stars. The visual should tell you the difficulty before you read a label.

lunar.name: Lunar Trail
lunar.description: Short hop. Established route. The sensible choice. You will not tell stories about this trip.
lunar.selection_flavor: Three months. Established corridors. Station every few jumps. You'll be fine. Probably.

mars.name: Mars Trail
mars.description: The middle road. Long enough for things to go wrong. Short enough that you might recover.

visual_palette.drift_objects: dust clouds, derelict fragments, old probes

mars.selection_flavor: Eight months. Some charted territory. Some not. The map has helpful annotations like 'here be problems.'

interstellar.name: Interstellar Trail
interstellar.description: The long road. Charts run out halfway. Something happens in the void. Nobody talks about what.

visual_palette.background: deep indigo to black, distant stars, vast emptiness
visual_palette.drift_objects: nothing for long stretches, then something that shouldn't be there

interstellar.selection_flavor: Fourteen months. The charts stop being useful around month six. The destination is called Far Garden. It was named by an optimist.

placement_rules.no_repeat_node_types: No two identical node_type values in a row
placement_rules.void_restriction: void nodes only appear after node 5 on interstellar maps
placement_rules.final_node_rule: Final node before destination is always a station
placement_rules.anomaly_restriction: anomaly nodes do not appear in first two legs
placement_rules.fork_differentiation: Each branch in a fork must have a different branch_flavor
placement_rules.station_guarantee: At least one station in the first third of any map
placement_rules.reconnection: Forked branches reconnect within 2-3 nodes — paths diverge, then merge

pity_counter.description: After 4 consecutive events tagged difficulty: hard or ultra, the engine temporarily weights toward easy/medium for the next 2 events.
pity_counter.notes: Pure engine logic. Not encoded in module tags. Prevents death spirals.
